title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 07/2019
source: Source: FOB Beyers M88's > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLIIS. Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with very good raw sound captures a high‑energy classic Dead show.
ai_review.review: The audience recording is praised as “very good” and faithful to the band’s raw live vibe, offering a clear, no‑frills listening experience. Reviewers highlight the tour’s classic energy, calling it the greatest touring band ever, even though no specific songs are singled out.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review; positive comments about both the recording and overall show, but limited detail for a higher confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape praised for its clear, raw sound and faithful capture of the band's live energy; no major flaws noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: General praise for a classic touring performance with consistent energy throughout.
